Question Choices: Select. What does Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) measure?: ~~The-average | The-total | How-spread-out-the-data-is | The-largest-number~~
Hints: MAD averages distances from the mean.
Solution: MAD is the mean of the absolute distances from the data mean. It measures spread, in the same units as the observations.
